title: 艺术实践与创作 · 100 句
description: 素描、绘画、摄影、音乐、舞台、写作、手工、设计、展出反馈和创作习惯。

items.zh: 先画轮廓，不急着填细节。
items.en: Start with the outline before adding detail.
answers: Start with the outline before adding detail.

items.zh: 这个角度让比例变了。
items.en: This angle changes the proportions.
answers: This angle changes the proportions.

items.zh: 影子向左边延伸。
items.en: The shadow extends to the left.
answers: The shadow extends to the left.

items.zh: 我勾线时下笔太重了。
items.en: I pressed too hard while drawing the lines.
answers: I pressed too hard while drawing the lines.
items.notes: while drawing：画线时；press too hard：下笔过重。

items.zh: 留白也是构图的一部分。
items.en: Empty space is part of the composition.
answers: Empty space is part of the composition.

items.zh: 这个物体挡住了背景。
items.en: This object obscures the background.
answers: This object obscures the background.

items.zh: 橡皮把纸面擦坏了。
items.en: The eraser damaged the paper surface.
answers: The eraser damaged the paper surface.

items.zh: 我想先画几个小草图。
items.en: I want to make a few thumbnail sketches.
answers: I want to make a few thumbnail sketches.

items.zh: 远处的边缘不那么清晰。
items.en: The distant edges are less distinct.
answers: The distant edges are less distinct.

items.zh: 这里需要更强的明暗对比。
items.en: This area needs stronger tonal contrast.
answers: This area needs stronger tonal contrast.

items.zh: 颜料还没完全干。
items.en: The paint has not fully dried.
answers: The paint has not fully dried.
The paint hasn't fully dried.

items.zh: 这两种颜色混在一起会变灰。
items.en: These colours turn grey when mixed.
answers: These colours turn grey when mixed.

items.zh: 刷子上沾了太多水。
items.en: There is too much water on the brush.
answers: There is too much water on the brush.

items.zh: 底层颜色透出来了。
items.en: The underpainting shows through.
answers: The underpainting shows through.

items.zh: 我想把过渡画得柔和一些。
items.en: I want to soften the transition.
answers: I want to soften the transition.

items.zh: 不要把所有区域都涂满。
items.en: Leave some areas unpainted.
answers: Leave some areas unpainted.

items.zh: 画布需要绷紧。
items.en: The canvas needs stretching.
answers: The canvas needs stretching.

items.zh: 这个绿色太鲜艳了。
items.en: This green is too vivid.
answers: This green is too vivid.

items.zh: 画面中阴影的方向与光源位置不一致。
items.en: The shadows do not match the position of the light source.
answers: The shadows do not match the position of the light source.
The shadows don't match the position of the light source.
items.notes: match：与……相符；区分光源位置和阴影方向。

items.zh: 我打算限制使用的颜色数量。
items.en: I plan to limit my colour palette.
answers: I plan to limit my colour palette.

items.zh: 人物的脸不在焦点上。
items.en: The person's face is out of focus.
answers: The person's face is out of focus.

items.zh: 背景比主体更抢眼。
items.en: The background distracts from the subject.
answers: The background distracts from the subject.

items.zh: 曝光时间太长，照片糊了。
items.en: The long exposure blurred the image.
answers: The long exposure blurred the image.

items.zh: 我们等光线柔和一点。
items.en: Let's wait for softer light.
answers: Let's wait for softer light.

items.zh: 这个画面需要水平校正。
items.en: The frame needs levelling.
answers: The frame needs levelling.

items.zh: 拍摄前先征得同意。
items.en: Get consent before taking the photograph.
answers: Get consent before taking the photograph.

items.zh: 我想保留自然的肤色。
items.en: I want to preserve natural skin tones.
answers: I want to preserve natural skin tones.

items.zh: 剪裁后，重点更明显了。
items.en: Cropping made the focal point clearer.
answers: Cropping made the focal point clearer.

items.zh: 反光遮住了文字。
items.en: The reflection obscures the lettering.
answers: The reflection obscures the lettering.

items.zh: 别把原始照片覆盖掉。
items.en: Do not overwrite the original photograph.
answers: Do not overwrite the original photograph.
Don't overwrite the original photograph.

items.zh: 我总在这一小节抢拍。
items.en: I keep rushing this bar.
answers: I keep rushing this bar.

items.zh: 先把速度降下来练。
items.en: Practise at a slower tempo first.
answers: Practise at a slower tempo first.

items.zh: 最后一个音需要延长。
items.en: The final note needs to be held.
answers: The final note needs to be held.

items.zh: 左手和右手没有配合好。
items.en: My hands are not coordinated yet.
answers: My hands are not coordinated yet.
My hands aren't coordinated yet.

items.zh: 这把吉他走音了。
items.en: This guitar is out of tune.
answers: This guitar is out of tune.

items.zh: 节拍器帮助我保持节奏。
items.en: The metronome helps me keep time.
answers: The metronome helps me keep time.

items.zh: 我把这一段分开练。
items.en: I practise this passage separately.
answers: I practise this passage separately.

items.zh: 换气的位置影响了乐句。
items.en: The breathing point affects the phrase.
answers: The breathing point affects the phrase.

items.zh: 这段旋律需要轻一些。
items.en: This melody needs a lighter touch.
answers: This melody needs a lighter touch.

items.zh: 我们从副歌前一小节开始。
items.en: Let's start one bar before the chorus.
answers: Let's start one bar before the chorus.

items.zh: 从观众席看不到这个动作。
items.en: The gesture is invisible from the audience seats.
answers: The gesture is invisible from the audience seats.

items.zh: 台词不要全部用同样的语气。
items.en: Vary the tone of your lines.
answers: Vary the tone of your lines.

items.zh: 我需要更清楚的上场提示。
items.en: I need a clearer entrance cue.
answers: I need a clearer entrance cue.

items.zh: 道具挡住了演员的路线。
items.en: The prop blocks the actor's path.
answers: The prop blocks the actor's path.

items.zh: 我们再走一遍换景流程。
items.en: Let's rehearse the scene change again.
answers: Let's rehearse the scene change again.

items.zh: 这个停顿可以再长一点。
items.en: The pause could be longer.
answers: The pause could be longer.

items.zh: 幕布还没完全打开。
items.en: The curtain has not opened fully.
answers: The curtain has not opened fully.
The curtain hasn't opened fully.

items.zh: 灯光提前亮了。
items.en: The lights came on too early.
answers: The lights came on too early.

items.zh: 演出有即兴发挥的部分。
items.en: The performance includes improvisation.
answers: The performance includes improvisation.

items.zh: 我不确定角色为什么离开。
items.en: I am unsure why the character leaves.
answers: I am unsure why the character leaves.

items.zh: 这个结尾透露得太早了。
items.en: The ending is revealed too soon.
answers: The ending is revealed too soon.

items.zh: 读者需要知道冲突的起因。
items.en: Readers need to understand the source of conflict.
answers: Readers need to understand the source of conflict.

items.zh: 对话听起来不像这个人物。
items.en: The dialogue sounds unlike this character.
answers: The dialogue sounds unlike this character.

items.zh: 我删掉了重复的描写。
items.en: I removed the repetitive description.
answers: I removed the repetitive description.

items.zh: 这段回忆打断了故事节奏。
items.en: This memory interrupts the pace of the story.
answers: This memory interrupts the pace of the story.

items.zh: 叙述者知道得比角色多。
items.en: The narrator knows more than the characters.
answers: The narrator knows more than the characters.

items.zh: 我想用一个细节暗示变化。
items.en: I want a detail that hints at change.
answers: I want a detail that hints at change.

items.zh: 标题不必解释全部内容。
items.en: The title need not explain everything.
answers: The title need not explain everything.
The title needn't explain everything.

items.zh: 这一章缺少明确的转折。
items.en: This chapter lacks a clear turning point.
answers: This chapter lacks a clear turning point.

items.zh: 初稿还不是最终版本。
items.en: A first draft is not the finished version.
answers: A first draft is not the finished version.
A first draft isn't the finished version.

items.zh: 缝线需要留一点余量。
items.en: Leave a little allowance for the seam.
answers: Leave a little allowance for the seam.

items.zh: 布料的纹路方向不同。
items.en: The fabrics have different grain directions.
answers: The fabrics have different grain directions.

items.zh: 胶水从边缘溢出来了。
items.en: Glue has seeped out at the edges.
answers: Glue has seeped out at the edges.

items.zh: 先试着拼合，再固定。
items.en: Check the fit before fastening the pieces.
answers: Check the fit before fastening the pieces.

items.zh: 这个接头承受不了重量。
items.en: This joint cannot support the weight.
answers: This joint cannot support the weight.
This joint can't support the weight.

items.zh: 木头的边缘有毛刺。
items.en: The wood has splinters along the edge.
answers: The wood has splinters along the edge.

items.zh: 我需要大小一致的珠子。
items.en: I need beads of uniform size.
answers: I need beads of uniform size.

items.zh: 陶土太干，开始开裂。
items.en: The clay is too dry and is cracking.
answers: The clay is too dry and is cracking.

items.zh: 这个图案可以沿边缘重复。
items.en: The pattern can repeat along the border.
answers: The pattern can repeat along the border.

items.zh: 我想保留手工制作的痕迹。
items.en: I want to retain signs of handwork.
answers: I want to retain signs of handwork.

items.zh: 这款字体的笔画太细，字号小时难以辨认。
items.en: The typeface has such thin strokes that it becomes hard to read at small sizes.
answers: The typeface has such thin strokes that it becomes hard to read at small sizes.
items.notes: such ... that 描述笔画粗细对可读性的影响。

items.zh: 图标和文字没有对齐。
items.en: The icon and text are misaligned.
answers: The icon and text are misaligned.

items.zh: 这个颜色对比不够强。
items.en: This colour contrast is insufficient.
answers: This colour contrast is insufficient.

items.zh: 我想先了解使用场景。
items.en: I want to understand the context of use first.
answers: I want to understand the context of use first.

items.zh: 装饰元素抢走了注意力。
items.en: The decorative elements draw attention away.
answers: The decorative elements draw attention away.

items.zh: 我们应该测试实际尺寸。
items.en: We should test it at its actual size.
answers: We should test it at its actual size.

items.zh: 空间太挤，信息难以区分。
items.en: The crowded layout makes information hard to separate.
answers: The crowded layout makes information hard to separate.

items.zh: 这个设计依赖颜色传递含义。
items.en: This design relies on colour to convey meaning.
answers: This design relies on colour to convey meaning.

items.zh: 我把最重要的信息放在前面。
items.en: I placed the essential information first.
answers: I placed the essential information first.

items.zh: 简化不等于删掉必要信息。
items.en: Simplification does not mean removing necessary information.
answers: Simplification does not mean removing necessary information.
Simplification doesn't mean removing necessary information.

items.zh: 作品标签应该放在视线高度。
items.en: The artwork label should be at eye level.
answers: The artwork label should be at eye level.

items.zh: 这幅画需要远一点看。
items.en: This painting needs viewing from further away.
answers: This painting needs viewing from further away.

items.zh: 照片不能准确呈现质感。
items.en: A photograph cannot fully capture the texture.
answers: A photograph cannot fully capture the texture.
A photograph can't fully capture the texture.

items.zh: 请具体指出哪里不清楚。
items.en: Please identify exactly what is unclear.
answers: Please identify exactly what is unclear.

items.zh: 我愿意修改，但想理解理由。
items.en: I am open to revision but want the reasoning.
answers: I am open to revision but want the reasoning.

items.zh: 两件作品放在一起更有意义。
items.en: The two works gain meaning when displayed together.
answers: The two works gain meaning when displayed together.

items.zh: 灯光在玻璃上产生了眩光。
items.en: The lighting creates glare on the glass.
answers: The lighting creates glare on the glass.

items.zh: 我需要注明素材来源。
items.en: I need to credit the source material.
answers: I need to credit the source material.

items.zh: 这份作品集缺少制作过程。
items.en: This portfolio lacks evidence of the process.
answers: This portfolio lacks evidence of the process.

items.zh: 观众的解读与我的初衷不同。
items.en: The audience's interpretation differs from my intention.
answers: The audience's interpretation differs from my intention.

items.zh: 我用小本子随时记下点子。
items.en: I capture ideas in a pocket notebook.
answers: I capture ideas in a pocket notebook.

items.zh: 限制材料反而促使我尝试。
items.en: Limited materials encouraged me to experiment.
answers: Limited materials encouraged me to experiment.

items.zh: 我需要暂时放下这件作品。
items.en: I need to step back from this piece.
answers: I need to step back from this piece.

items.zh: 临摹帮助我观察技法。
items.en: Copying helps me observe technique.
answers: Copying helps me observe technique.

items.zh: 练习作品也值得保留。
items.en: Practice pieces are worth keeping.
answers: Practice pieces are worth keeping.

items.zh: 这次失败让我看见结构问题。
items.en: This failure revealed a structural problem.
answers: This failure revealed a structural problem.

items.zh: 我想知道观众首先注意到什么。
items.en: I want to know what viewers notice first.
answers: I want to know what viewers notice first.

items.zh: 完成比无限修改更重要。
items.en: Finishing matters more than endless revision.
answers: Finishing matters more than endless revision.

items.zh: 我们给不同方案留出尝试时间。
items.en: We allow time to explore different approaches.
answers: We allow time to explore different approaches.

items.zh: 灵感需要通过实际制作检验。
items.en: Inspiration needs testing through making.
answers: Inspiration needs testing through making.
